wire_format: ASCII JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators; finite JSON numbers; list order preserved

pre_action_public_state.public_entity_ids: four unique UAV strings; zero to six unique task strings in public action-slot order
pre_action_public_state.public_history: optional causal 128 float32 values and fixed schema; no future labels

event_signal.meaning: any public semantic trigger at the saved pre-action observation boundary

event_signal_valid.false: unknown; reject before flatten/model; never recode as an observed negative

candidate_key.unbound_observation: null only before candidate catalog binding; no current task slot

legal_mask.effective_mask: public safety filter output; must equal saved candidate catalog mask

snapshot_identity.source_sha256_scope: typed public graph/telemetry/time/version/event/IDs/continuation/public trigger record plus source header; effective mask and causal history separately bound in full prefix and candidate context
snapshot_identity.private_environment_snapshot: separate strict payload/canonical digests and saved time/random key/history binding; never added to learned features

flat_cache: derived only; validate named fields and cached scalar sources before producing a new vector; float64/type/shape/mismatch rejected
native_conversion_boundary: capture_observation only; native float32 arrays and native tuples explicitly converted to wire lists there; consumers validate types before any conversion
candidate_records: complete public state once plus compact per-candidate prefix/source/key/snapshot digests; all records validated before tensor/model entry
restore: snapshot_payload envelope; saved public state exclusively; no restored/current environment observation, private trigger inspection or branch-end input
failure: named field/type/shape/value and producer/consumer source digests; no expected-value adjustment, no silent renaming
compatibility: 770 float32 public dimensions, candidate and adapter dimensions unchanged; new checkpoint and replay metadata mandatory
